tldr: Gemini rising: curious, observant, and quick to translate the room.
body: With Gemini rising, you meet life through questions, movement, language, and variety. Your path asks you to keep learning without scattering yourself across every open tab of possibility.
approach: Connects quickly, gathers information, and adapts through conversation and observation.
shadow: Overthinking, nervous distraction, or using cleverness to stay one step away from commitment.
note: Authored from Marie Satori Big Three and sign material.
